### `xmltemplated` matcher

Templated XML match: leaf tokens `{{ ignore }}` and `{{ regex: PATTERN }}` are honoured; children matched order-independently. Non-string or unparseable XML never matches. https://docs.hoverfly.io/en/latest/pages/keyconcepts/matching/matchers.html

**Value type:** `string`
**Config:** not supported.
**doMatch:** AND-semantics; re-tests the same input against the next matcher.
